name: command
title: Command
description: A searchable palette of actions that opens over the page, with an optional global shortcut.
a11y: A modal dialog named by a hidden title; focus moves to the search input and returns to the opener on close.
The input is an ARIA combobox controlling a listbox of grouped options; focus stays in the input and aria-activedescendant names the active option.
ArrowUp and ArrowDown move (skipping disabled items), Home and End jump, Enter runs the item, Escape closes.
The shortcut prop toggles the palette from anywhere (mod is Cmd on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere); result count is announced through a status region.

props.name: items
props.description: The actions to list, each with an `id`, `label` and optional `group`, `keywords`, `hint`, `disabled` and `onSelect`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the palette is open when controlled. Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the palette starts open when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new open state when the palette opens or closes.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A global key that toggles the palette, like `mod+k` (`mod` is Cmd on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text of the search box. Default "Type a command".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Message shown when no item matches the search. Default "No results".

props.name: trigger
props.description: Optional trigger element, rendered as-is (use a Button with aria-haspopup="dialog").

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class name for the palette panel.
